settings.question: How does the 30-day trial work?
settings.answer: Sleep on any {AppName} product for 30 nights. If it is not the best sleep you have had, start a return from your account and we will make it right.

settings.question: Are {AppName} comforters and pillows machine washable?
settings.answer: Yes. Every comforter and pillow cover is designed to be washed at home on a gentle cycle and tumble dried low.

settings.question: Which side of the CloudCool comforter is the cool side?
settings.answer: The smooth, silk-touch side is the cooling side. The soft knit side is for cooler nights. Flip it whenever you like.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days and typically arrive in 3-6 business days. Tracking is emailed as soon as your order leaves our warehouse.
